title: Plumbing
description: At Specialised Plumbing Installation we strive to provide solutions for various reticulated water and wet fire systems. Our company offers the installation of plumbing and domestic irrigation systems, general repair or refurbishment of your fixtures, and we service onsite treatment plants, backflow devices and thermostatic mixing valves. We also provide in‑ground storm water and sewer works and above‑ground sanitary plumbing for domestic housing, retail shops, offices and other commercial establishments.

title: Fire Suppression
description: We have developed a number of solutions to reduce the risks of fire hazards. Over the years we have installed and maintained in‑ground fire hydrant systems, above‑ground steel hydrant systems, hose reel systems and fire sprinkler systems for domestic, commercial and agricultural applications. Our fire suppression systems are also well suited to rural and agricultural settings such as machinery sheds, stables and feed storage sheds.

title: Gas LPG & Natural
description: Handling gas systems and appliances can be tricky and it is a legal requirement in Australia to engage a licenced gas fitter for such works. SPI QLD has the capacity to work on a variety of gas installation requirements – from swapping out appliances to installing complete gas supply systems and servicing hot water systems or food outlets.

title: Roofing
description: Roofing, metal gutters and down‑pipe work are considered the bread and butter disciplines of the plumbing industry. We provide repairs and alterations to roofs, gutters and down pipes, and we supply and install rain water collection tanks above or below ground together with all associated pumping.
